title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chozhan rejoices as Vannathi stands against Chandayatha and shares his happiness with Pallavan and Nila. Enraged by Pandian's confrontation, Vannathi proposes to Aravind.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 83: VJS Sets Things Straight
description: Family week brings memories as VJS engages with the housemates. However, the mood shifts when VJS addresses internal conflicts and raises questions about leadership.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
episodeTitle: Arjun Rushes to Stop the Wedding
description: Shyam and Madhu reach the registrar's office to marry while Saranya urges Arjun to bring Madhu home. Ajun's friends ask Madhu to stall as Arjun rushes in to stop the wedding.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Vennila fumes as Anbu is chief guest for Kanmani's shop opening, while Kanmani dreams of him. Ahead of the final court hearing, Kanmani tells Thenmozhi she wants to live with Anbu.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Muthuvel offers Senthil job help as he refuses to enter Pandian's house. Shocked to see Thangamayil home, Anjali says her father is dead and Saravanan is her last hope.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Annamalai and others are shocked by Vijaya's noisy workout as Muthu teases her. Later, Meena, Rohini and Shruthi set out for their first order with Muthu and Ravi.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Abinaya is overwhelmed as painful memories resurface upon entering Mahesh's home. Swetha deeply regrets Vetri and Abinaya's separation, hoping to reunite them.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi is overjoyed as doctors confirm her pregnancy. After a long wait at the temple, she shares the happy news with Paraman, making the moment special.
